sn35.83:1.1: atha kho āyasmā phagguno yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā phagguno bhagavantaṃ etadavoca.
sn35.83:2.1: atthi nu kho bhante, taṃ cakkhu yena cakkhunā atīte buddhe parinibbute chinnapapañce chinnavaṭume pariyādinnavaṭṭe sabbadukkhavītivatte paññāpayamāno paññāpeyya …pe…
sn35.83:2.2: atthi nu kho sā bhante, jivhā yāya jivhāya atīte buddhe parinibbute …pe…
sn35.83:2.3: atthi nu kho so bhante, mano yena manena atīte buddhe parinibbute chinnapapañce chinnavaṭume pariyādinnavaṭṭe sabbadukkhavītivatte paññāpayamāno paññāpeyyāti.
